column1: # Eyes Studio licence table (ticket S1.14). Reviewed by hand; the notices are
# generated from it and the resolved studio-desktop runtime graph by the sbt
# build (project/StudioNotices.scala). The build fails (generating the notices
# and in checkStudioNotices) when a resolved module matches no dependency rule,
# or a licence id has no text in
# Every rule names one artifact exactly, so a new artifact of a known group
# needs a reviewed row of its own.
# Licences are as each artifact's POM declares them (OpenJFX and SLF4J declare
# none in their POMs; theirs are from the projects' own LICENSE files).
# --- logging (S1.12). These two rules match no module until S1.12 (p0-s112) adds
# SLF4J and Logback; checkStudioNotices logs them as unused until then.
